description: This Java source file defines the LoanDisbursementService class, which manages loan disbursement-related operations within a loan management system. It includes functionalities such as updating disbursement details, adjusting disbursement amounts, handling disbursement transactions, and managing disbursement details including creation, update, and removal. The class interacts with other domain objects and services to facilitate processing of loan disbursements, handling multiple tranches, and ensuring compliance with business rules.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing loan disbursement operations, including updating disbursement details, adjusting amounts, handling disbursement transactions, and managing loan disbursement records, ensuring compliance with business rules, and handling multiple tranche disbursements.

methods.name: updateDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Updates the disbursement details of a loan based on provided JSON command, handling creation, modification, and removal of disbursement tranches and charges accordingly.

methods.name: adjustDisburseAmount
methods.description: Adjusts the disbursed amount for a loan, updating disbursement dates and handling multiple tranches or disbursal scenarios.

methods.name: handleDisbursementTransaction
methods.description: Handles the transaction logic related to disbursing a loan, including fees, charges applied at disbursal, and journal entries.

methods.name: createOrUpdateDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Creates a new disbursement record or updates an existing one, including associated tranche charges.

methods.name: removeDisbursementAndAssociatedCharges
methods.description: Removes disbursement records and their associated charges, either all or selectively based on charge IDs.

methods.name: removeChargesByDisbursementID
methods.description: Removes all charges associated with a specific disbursement ID.

methods.name: getDateFormatAndLocale
methods.description: Extracts date format and locale information from a JSON command if available.

methods.name: parseDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Parses disbursement details such as date, amount, and charge ID from a JSON object.

methods.name: hasMultipleOrPreDefinedDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Determines if the loan has multiple or pre-defined disbursement details.

methods.name: sortDisbursementDetailsByBusinessRules
methods.description: Sorts disbursement details based on expected date, principal amount, and ID following business rules.

methods.name: hasMultipleTranchesOnSameDate
methods.description: Checks if there are multiple disbursement tranches on the same date.

methods.name: hasMultipleTranchesOnSameDateWithSameExpectedDate
methods.description: Checks if there are multiple tranches scheduled for the same date.
